title: Full rescue line · Level 1
brief: Our own map of 300 mm tiles (a black line about 20 mm wide on white) on all 24 cells of 6 x 4, laid by the simulator's map builder: the Start tile, two 150 mm gaps on straights (a custom tile), a T junction (#70) whose green marker turns the robot on its way back, a dead end in the top row (a T entered by its stem with a marker on each side: turn round), a crossing (#80) whose markers turn the robot each time it is driven, round corners of radius 150 mm, and the Goal tile, 7.22 m of line. The robot is G6.3's (the robot file rescue-line-open, G8.4's: sensors 1 and 2 24 mm ahead, 16 mm each side, sensor 3 facing forward, sensor 4 on the centre line, a side distance sensor on I2C 7, the arm and claw); a run on a changed robot is not this level's. It starts on the Start tile on the line, facing along it, moved up to 10 mm and turned up to 5 degrees (run 1 too). The RCJ referee judges: tiles reached in order (5.4.6), a lack of progress called when the robot passes the next tile's exit off the line (5.5.1b) or takes a wrong line (5.5.1c), then put back on the Start tile. A run ends once the program has ended and the robot has then stood still for 0.5 s (both drive motors slower than 5 deg/s, the robot slower than 3 mm/s; the run's time is when that stillness began), after 3 lacks of progress, or after 180 s. The robot has stopped on the Goal when the run ended on that stillness with its axle's middle on the Goal tile. Score: 60 x the fraction of the line completed (the line through the tiles passed in order before the first lack of progress), + 20 x min(1, par / time) if it stopped on the Goal, + 20 if no lack of progress was called. Par 70 s (the record's). Pass: a mean of at least 60 over the 5 runs, and at least 4 of 5 stop on the Goal.

score.run: 60 * fraction + if(goal, 20 * min(1, par / goalTime), 0) + if(lops == 0, 20, 0)
score.summary: round(sum(r in runs: r.points) / count(r in runs: true), 1)

pass: sum(r in runs: r.points) / count(r in runs: true) >= 60 & count(r in runs: r.goal) >= 0.8 * n
